Adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
Adjustments.body: Stock adjustments are reason-coded manual changes to on-hand quantities: breakage, shrinkage, found stock or counting errors. Every adjustment carries a reason and is posted as its own stock movement; the quantity itself is never overwritten directly. A wrong adjustment is undone by a reversing adjustment that points back to the original. Who changed what, when and why stays traceable.
